newsitem.title: USA: Farmers get $5.3 Bln in FY96 farm subsidies-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Farmers get $5.3 Bln in FY96 farm subsidies-USDA.

text.p: U.S. farmers will get $5.3 billion in crop subsidies in fiscal 1996 under the Freedom to Farm law, the Agriculture Department said Friday.
Payments included $1.976 billion for wheat, $1.77 billion for corn, $206 million for sorghum, $141 million for barley, $9 million for oats, $746 million for cotton and $472 million for rice.

Texas farmers led the nation with $503 million in payments, followed by Kansas with $428 million, Iowa with $353 million, Illinois with $341 million, North Dakota with $311 million and Nebraska with $305 million.
